name: line-chart
title: Line Chart
description: A gridded line chart over time with an optional total header, an optional change against the previous period, and a hover tooltip. Uses namespace exports: LineChart.Root.

docs.lead: A single series over time on a light grid. Pass a total to show a figure above the chart; add a delta to show how it moved.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A total with its change, and a tooltip that also compares each point with the one before.
examples.code:
<LineChart.Root
  points={points}
  total={{ label: "Total", value: 68, delta: 33.3, comparison: "vs previous period" }}
  pointComparison="vs prev."
/>

examples.title: Without delta
examples.description: A total on its own, for a range with nothing before it to compare against.

api.name: LineChart.Root
api.description: The header and chart. Fills its container's height.

props.name: points
props.description: Points oldest first. label is the tooltip caption, so format dates first

props.name: total
props.type: { label: string; value: number; delta?: number | null; comparison?: string }
props.description: A caption over a figure above the chart. Omit it and the chart takes the whole height

props.name: pointComparison
props.description: When set, the tooltip shows each point's change from the one before, followed by this text
